title: Without a key, a lost reply turns one payment into two charges
caption: The client can't tell "never arrived" from "done, reply lost", so it retries, and the server has no way to know it already did the work.

messages.label: POST /pay $30
messages.note: The first attempt reaches the server.

messages.label: charge $30
messages.note: The side effect happens: the customer is charged once.

messages.label: 201 Created (lost)
messages.note: The reply is dropped by a flaky mobile link or a proxy timeout. The client only sees a timeout.

messages.label: POST /pay $30 (retry)
messages.note: Retrying is the only safe-looking move, and the request is identical.

messages.label: charge $30 again
messages.note: The server treats it as a new payment. The customer is now charged $60 for one checkout.
